'''February 2002 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Joliet, IL on 16 February 2002. [[Eric Olson]] won it. It is known from Al Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3376">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-16-joliet-il-2-16-02-aka-dont-quit-sichtad3376/ joliet-il-2-16-02-aka-dont-quit-sichta], DeckTech (Al "MoTU" Schaefer, 16 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-16-joliet-il-2-16-02-aka-dont-quit-sichtad3376/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 February 2002
* '''Site:''' Joliet, IL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Olson]]
